memory.text: Protagonist possesses unusual strength and combat ability that surprises opponents. He has a powerful fear magic ability but he has yet to reveal it.
Protagonist entered the tournament to investigate the disappearance of his fellow warrior from a previous tournament. Rumors exist of other participants vanishing as well.

Rachel is the protagonist's assigned VIP attendant for the tournament duration (three days, possibly longer). Attendants are tasked with gathering intel on their clients under the guise of hospitality.

"That's three to none." I offered a hand.

She stared up at me, chest heaving, a mix of frustration and fascination narrowing her eyes. "You're not using any mana. I would've felt it."

"Maybe my magic's too strong for you to detect."

"I've never heard of that." She took my hand and let me pull her up. "I can take a hint. Keep your secrets."

She brushed herself off, and I could see her recalibrating—the way fighters do when they realize they've misjudged someone. The three challengers I'd faced earlier in the public ring had worn that same look before they hit the ground. The difference was Rachel had lasted longer than any of them, and she'd taken the loss with more grace. None of them were who I came here for, but asking around too openly wasn't an option.
